 Korean Skincare Brand Fully Launches at Sephora Stores Nationwide
 The US launch follows Fully's expansion into Sephora in six Asia-Pacific markets. 
 October 29, 2026 
 By: Lianna Albrizio 
 Associate Editor , Happi 
 Save 
 Image caption -->
 K-beauty brand Fully is living up to its name.
 The vegan skincare brand has expanded its US retail presence with a nationwide launch at more than 580 Sephora stores through the Olive Young K-Beauty Edit.
 Fully products became available in stores and online beginning in August, marking the brand’s largest brick-and-mortar expansion in the US to date, officials said.
 The US launch follows Fully’s expansion into Sephora in six Asia-Pacific markets — Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Australia and New Zealand — in March.
 K-Beauty Edit
 The Sephora lineup is led by Fully’s bestselling Green Tomato Clay Mask Cleanser , a 2-in-1 clay mask and cleanser that has become one of the brand’s best-known products in the US. In 2025, Cardi B featured the product on TikTok, referring to it as the “Last Boss” of K-beauty. That same year, Women’s Health Magazine dubbed it “Best Clay Mask” in the publication’s Skincare Awards.
 The Green Tomato Clay Mask Cleanser has reportedly sold more than 3.5 million units worldwide. The creamy clay formula is applied as a mask, then transforms into a rich foam with water to cleanse away excess sebum and pore buildup.
 Fully is also introducing its rice-based skincare lineup to US Sephora shoppers. Inspired by the longstanding use of rice in Korean beauty routines, the collection combines rice-derived ingredients with formulas focused on hydration, barrier support and radiance.
 Other items in the lineup are the Rice PDRN Glow Boosting Serum, formulated with rice-derived PDRN, rice bran water, ceramides and adenosine; Rice-Dough Mask Cleanser; Rice Ceramide Essence Toner; Rice Ceramide Moisturizing Cream; and Rice Ceramide Moisture Sunscreen.
